tools.name: search_aircraft
tools.description: Finds the aircraft types TrimCarbon has figures for, by name (e.g. "Cessna 172", "Skyhawk"), ICAO type designator (e.g. "C172", "PA28") or page slug. Returns each type with its kg of CO₂ per flight hour. The list covers about 60 general-aviation types, plus a few airliners (per passenger) and busine

tools.name: estimate_flight_hours
tools.description: Estimates the CO₂ from flying hours in one or more aircraft types: one row for a pilot, several rows for a fleet (a school, club or operator). CO₂ = hours × the type’s kg of CO₂ per flight hour, from its fuel flow at about 75% power. Types match by name, ICAO type designator or page slug.

tools.name: estimate_fuel_burn
tools.description: Estimates the CO₂ from burning an amount of aviation fuel: avgas 100LL, mogas (motor gasoline) or Jet A, in US gallons, liters or kg. Uses the US EPA factor per US gallon and the fuel’s density for liters and kg.

tools.name: import_logbook
tools.description: Opens a card where the user picks a logbook export from ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot or LogTen. The card reads the file on the user’s device, uploads nothing, and shows the flight hours and CO₂ by aircraft type. The user can then share those totals with this conversation. tools.name: quote_offset
tools.description: Returns what TrimCarbon charges to offset an amount of CO₂: a one-time purchase in whole tonnes, and for yearly amounts the monthly and yearly plans. Each option has a link to continue on trimcarbon.com, where the user signs up and pays. This tool does not buy anything. It is for when the user asks

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Shows the signed-in TrimCarbon account: email, current offset plan (monthly or yearly, kg of CO₂ per period, renewal date) and offset API access. Needs the user to connect their TrimCarbon account.

tools.name: get_my_impact
tools.description: Shows how much CO₂ the signed-in user has offset with TrimCarbon: the total, what is still being processed, by source (one-time, subscription, offset API), by year, and the projects funded. Needs the user to connect their TrimCarbon account.

tools.name: list_my_offsets
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user’s TrimCarbon offset orders, newest first: date, source, kg of CO₂, status and the public certificate link once issued. Needs the user to connect their TrimCarbon account.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Shows one of the signed-in user’s TrimCarbon certificates: kg of CO₂, holder, dates, projects with their registries and retirement serial numbers, and links to the public certificate and its PDF. Takes the certificate number (TC-7K2M-9QXF-4HJD) that list_my_offsets returns. Needs the user to connect

tools.name: get_api_impact
tools.description: For a company that uses the TrimCarbon offset API: how much CO₂ it has offset through the API, in total, in the last 30 days and by month, and its API access status. Needs the user to connect their TrimCarbon account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_account · Private data: import_logbook · Public sink: import_logbook, get_my_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_account · Private data: import_logbook · Public sink: import_logbook, get_my_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
